`final class TextMarkup`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.markup` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TextMarkup.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/markup/TextMarkup.java)

The registry of the markup tags that every text reads, and the helpers that find the tags in a string.

## Description

JOID registers no markup: the tags a text understands are the ones you register, or the ones you give a style with [`TextInfo.markups`](/reference/text/textinfo/#TextInfo-property-markups).

<a id="TextMarkup-method-parse"></a>

### parse

`int parse(List<ITextMarkup> markups, String text, int index, TextStyle style)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Tries each markup of `markups` at `index` and returns the length of the first tag found, or `0` when no tag starts there.

<a id="TextMarkup-method-tags"></a>

### tags

`int[] tags(String text, TextInfo info)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns, for each character of `text`, the index where the tag that holds it starts, or `-1` for a character outside any tag, with the markups of `info`.

<a id="TextMarkup-method-opened"></a>

### opened

`String opened(String text, int[] tags, int end)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns every tag found in `text` before `end`, joined, so that a line that starts at `end` reopens the styles of the previous one.
